landing.hero_title: Judicial Summaries Built on Verification, Not Assumptions
landing.hero_subtitle: NyayaLens empowers Indian courts, advocates, law students, and citizens with paragraph-anchored faithfulness verification, automated citation auditing, and operative directions extraction.
landing.diff1_desc: Every single summary claim carries direct source paragraph citations. Clicking any tag highlights the original text and explains its factual support status.
landing.diff2_desc: Upload petitions, orders, or drafts to verify case reporters (AIR, SCC, SCR) against authentic repositories with quote fidelity checks.
landing.diff3_desc: Isolates the court's enforceable commands, responsible parties, and deadlines into an actionable checklist.
landing.comparison_text: Generative models frequently invent citations and hallucinate judicial ratio. NyayaLens binds every output to verified paragraphs and statutory gazettes.
